resources.title: TOP 10 Valheim mods you NEED (never be bored again) 2026
resources.creator: Anabriella
resources.noteEs: Top 10 mods curados para 2026 — mezcla QoL (ExtraSlots, Smart Containers) con gameplay (Epic Loot, Therzie's). Bueno como punto de entrada al modding con picks vigentes post-Call to Arms.
resources.noteEn: Top 10 curated mods for 2026 — mixes QoL (ExtraSlots, Smart Containers) with gameplay (Epic Loot, Therzie's). A good entry point to modding with picks current post-Call to Arms.

resources.title: Valheim...as it SHOULD Have Been | 25 Mods I'd Die Without
resources.creator: SnazzyGames
resources.noteEs: Lista más larga (25) y opinionada — SnazzyGames argumenta por qué cada mod debería ser parte de tu setup base. Útil para construir una modlist sólida más allá del 'top 10' obvio.
resources.noteEn: Longer (25) and more opinionated list — SnazzyGames argues why each mod should be part of your base setup. Useful for building a solid modlist beyond the obvious top 10.

resources.title: Valheim's Best Quality-of-life Mods You Need
resources.creator: EmmaTpotato
resources.noteEs: Curaduría enfocada solo en QoL (no gameplay-altering). Mods seguros que no rompen balance — quitan friction sin cambiar la experiencia. Para puristas que quieren mejoras sin transformar el juego.
resources.noteEn: Curation focused only on QoL (no gameplay-altering). Safe mods that don't break balance — they remove friction without changing the experience. For purists wanting improvements without transforming the game.

resources.title: Top mods For Valheim of 2024
resources.creator: JustBlaza
resources.noteEs: Cobertura de 2024 con énfasis post-Ashlands. JustBlaza muestra los mods que aún funcionan tras Ashlands y cuáles se rompieron. Buena referencia histórica de qué mods sobrevivieron major patches.
resources.noteEn: 2024 coverage with post-Ashlands emphasis. JustBlaza shows mods still working after Ashlands and which ones broke. Good historical reference for which mods survived major patches.

resources.title: VALHEIM - Instala 10 MODS Esenciales con R2modman
resources.creator: Nyam Lord
resources.noteEs: Tutorial en español de cómo instalar r2modman y los 10 mods más esenciales paso a paso. Único recurso del codex en español para esta categoría — útil para hispanohablantes que arrancan modeo.
resources.noteEn: Spanish-language tutorial on how to install r2modman and the 10 most essential mods step by step. The only Spanish-language resource in this category — useful for Spanish-speakers starting to mod.
